subject: Post-call: volume & model mix — initial cost estimates
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@fastretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: volume & model mix — initial cost estimates

Hi Emily — thanks again for the chat today. Quick recap and next steps so we all stay aligned.

Call summary (very high-level)
- Use case: personalized product search + in-session recommendations on web + mobile (search autocomplete, re-rank for search results, short-form commerce copy).
- Expected user signals: 10–12M web sessions/month, ~1.2M active search queries/month initially.
- SLA ask: 95th pct latency < 120ms for search re-rank path, nightly batch embedding updates.

Requested from you
- Confirmed monthly token estimate range: you mentioned a ballpark of 12M–20M tokens/month across interactive chat/query endpoints (please confirm exact target).
- Procurement lead & timeline — cc'ed procurement@fastretail.com if you'd like me to include them on the next thread.

Our immediate next steps (what I'll do)
1) Share a lightweight blended cost sketch based on the volumes you mentioned (attached).
2) Propose an initial model mix and per-path unit economics to match your latency and cost targets.
3) If useful, set up a short follow-up with our solutions engineer to finalize sequence length assumptions.

Attachments: Redwood_Estimate_Q1.pdf (high-level cost sketch), FastRetail_usage_template.xlsx (usage template for you to populate).

Questions for you (one-liners)
- Can you confirm whether embeddings will be used primarily for re-rank/indexing (nightly jobs) or also for real-time augmentation?
- Is there an internal target for blended cost (e.g. target $/1M tokens) we should be trying to hit?

Happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier. Thanks —

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0133

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@fastretail.com>

Cc: procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: volume & model mix — initial cost estimates

Thanks Vanessa — this looks helpful. A few clarifications: 

- The 12M–20M tokens/month I mentioned was for the first 90 days of the pilot. We expect growth to 80–120M tokens/month in 6–9 months if the pilot performs.
- Embeddings: primarily nightly index updates (not real-time) but we'll need ~10k near-real-time lookups/day for personalization.
- Target blended cost: procurement is looking for target ~ $1,000–1,500 per 1M tokens as a negotiation anchor; we realize chat-heavy activity will be higher.

Can you split the sketch into pilot vs production scenarios? Also please call out assumptions about average prompt + response lengths per path (search re-rank vs recommendation vs short chat).

Best,
Emily
Emily Chen
Sr. Product Manager, Search & Personalization
FastRetail

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@fastretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement@fastretail.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2026 13:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: volume & model mix — initial cost estimates

Emily — great, thanks for the specifics. I updated the attached sketch to show two scenarios (Pilot: 15M tokens/mo; Prod: 100M tokens/mo). Below are the headline assumptions and a proposed model mix so procurement has something concrete to evaluate.

Assumptions (per-path average token use)- Search re-rank path: prompt 80 tokens, response 40 tokens, average 1.3 model calls per query (includes context)- Recommendation short-form (in-session suggestion): prompt 60 tokens, response 50 tokens- Embeddings (batch index updates): 512 tokens per document, nightly run; real-time lookups negligible token cost (embedding lookup billed per embed call)

Proposed model mix (blended by token volume)- Chat/generation (interactive search + recommendations): 60%- Embeddings (indexing + occasional retrieval calls): 30%- Rerank API (specialized small-context rerank model for search): 10%

Example unit economics (illustrative target pricing)- Chat/generation model: $2,200 per 1M tokens- Embeddings (per-embed equivalent): $250 per 1M tokens (blended equivalence)- Rerank model: $800 per 1M tokens

Blended target range (based on mix above)- Pilot (15M tokens/mo): blended unit cost ~ $1,045 per 1M tokens (pilot weighting & reserved usage not included)- Prod (100M tokens/mo): blended unit cost ~ $1,420 per 1M tokens (higher chat ratio at scale + SLA requirements)

Notes: these are initial, negotiable anchors. We can reduce the blended cost materially through: reserved capacity commits, burst-to-dedicated routing, and model quantization/selection for the rerank path. I'll flag options in a follow-up price sheet.

If that range aligns with procurement's anchor (~$1,000–1,500), I recommend we: 1) run a quick sequence-length calibration (15–30m) with your team; 2) have Karthik propose reserved-commit tiers and a short-term pilot discount for Q2.

I attached the updated sketch (Redwood_Estimate_Q1.pdf) and the usage template — feel free to populate the sheet and send back. Happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up Thursday to walk the numbers.

Best,
Vanessa

Folks — forwarding the thread. Procurement is anchored at $1k–1.5k /1M tokens and prefers pilot -> production ramp. Can you: 
1) Draft a short reserved-commit proposal (tiers: 0–25M, 25–100M, 100M+) with associated blended $/1M targets and any pilot discount we can offer?
2) Call out options to lower cost (quantized rerank, dedicated pools, burst credits) and estimated impact on blended unit economics.
3) Prepare a 1-page appendix with explicit assumptions (seq len, calls per query, embed call counts) so procurement can validate numbers.

I've attached the usage template and the updated estimate. Want to get a proposal in front of them before Thursday EOD.

Thanks —
Vanessa
